title: Why Didn't Hanuman Defeat Vali?
status: DRAFT v1: Uttara 7.35-36 and Kishkindha 4.65-66 read; Manas lines checked; voices wait for the ElevenLabs top-up
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 7.35-36 and Kishkindha Kanda 4.65-66 (Critical Edition)

claims.claim: Rama asks Agastya why Hanuman, so mighty, did not burn Vali like a creeper when the feud with Sugriva arose
claims.quote_sa: किमर्थं वाली चैतेन सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया । तदा वैरे समुत्पन्ने न दग्धो वीरुधो यथा ॥

claims.claim: With the gods' boons the child was full of strength and fearlessly troubled the sages' hermitages
Sages of the Bhrigu and Angiras lines cursed him: he would not know his strength for a long time; his vigour was taken and he became gentle
claims.quote_sa: बाधसे यत् समाश्रित्य बलमस्मान्प्लवंगम । तद्दीर्घकालं वेत्तासि नास्माकं शापमोहितः ॥

claims.claim: Because of the curse Hanuman did not know his strength when the Vali-Sugriva feud arose, even while Sugriva was being hounded
claims.quote_sa: एष शापवशादेव न वेद बलमात्मनः । वालिसुग्रीवयोर्वैरं यदा राम समुत्थितम् ॥
sources: enjoylearningsanskrit (CE); subject eṣa = Hanuman (the page's English says Sugriva)

claims.claim: He learned grammar facing the sun, moving backwards from the rising to the setting mountain

claims.claim: Jambavan: in strength, wisdom, brilliance and courage you surpass all beings; why do you not know yourself?

shots.hi: हनुमान जी इतने बलवान थे, तो सुग्रीव को बाली से क्यों नहीं बचाया? ये सवाल, खुद श्रीराम ने पूछा था।
shots.en: Hanuman was so mighty, so why didn't he save Sugriva from Vali? Rama himself asked this.

[curious] ये सवाल, खुद श्रीराम ने पूछा था।

shots.hi: वाल्मीकि रामायण, उत्तर कांड, सर्ग छत्तीस। बाधसे यत् समाश्रित्य बलमस्मान्प्लवंगम। तद्दीर्घकालं वेत्तासि नास्माकं शापमोहितः॥ ये है असली कहानी।
units: वाल्मीकि रामायण, उत्तर कांड, सर्ग छत्तीस।
[reverently] [slowly] बाधसे यत् समाश्रित्य, बलमस्मान्प्लवंगम… तद्दीर्घकालं वेत्तासि, नास्माकं शापमोहितः॥
[serious] ये है असली कहानी।

sloka.en: “O monkey, the strength you lean on to harass us, you will not know it for a long time, bewildered by our curse.”
sloka.translit: bādhase yat samāśritya balamasmānplavaṃgama, taddīrghakālaṃ vettāsi nāsmākaṃ śāpamohitaḥ

shots.hi: तुलसीदास जी लिखते हैं, जामवंत ने कहा: कहइ रीछपति सुनु हनुमाना… का चुप साधि रहेहु बलवाना।

quote.translit: kahai rīchhapati sunu hanumānā, kā chup sādhi rahehu balavānā
quote.en: “Said the king of bears: listen, Hanuman, O mighty one, why do you sit silent?”

shots.hi: हे वानरश्रेष्ठ, बल, बुद्धि, तेज और साहस, सबमें तुम सबसे आगे हो। फिर तुम खुद को क्यों नहीं पहचानते?
shots.en: "O best of monkeys, in strength, wisdom, brilliance and courage you surpass all. Why do you not know yourself?"
units: हे वानरश्रेष्ठ, बल, बुद्धि, तेज और साहस, सबमें तुम सबसे आगे हो।
फिर तुम खुद को क्यों नहीं पहचानते?

shots.hi: ये सुनकर, हनुमान जी का शरीर बढ़ने लगा। पर वो अपना बल भूले क्यों थे? जवाब, उत्तर कांड में है।
shots.en: Hearing this, Hanuman began to grow. But why had he forgotten his strength? The answer is in the Uttara Kanda.
units: [engaged] ये सुनकर, हनुमान जी का शरीर बढ़ने लगा।

[storytelling] जवाब, उत्तर कांड में है।

shots.hi: मुनिवर, जब बाली और सुग्रीव में बैर हुआ, तब हनुमान ने, सुग्रीव के लिए, बाली को एक बेल की तरह क्यों नहीं जला दिया?
shots.en: "Great sage, when the feud between Vali and Sugriva arose, why did Hanuman not burn Vali down like a creeper, for Sugriva's sake?"

verify_note: Uttara 7.35.1-15 and 7.36 (46 verses), Kishkindha 4.65-66 read (research/A38/). Page English mislabels the subject in 7.35.11 (says Rama; etena = Hanuman) and 7.36.39 (says Sugriva; eṣa = Hanuman). Manas: ramcharit.in, after doha 29. Notes: research/A38_hanuman_forgot.md
caption: Hanuman was so mighty, so why didn't he save Sugriva from Vali? In Valmiki's Ramayana (Critical Edition), Rama himself asks this of the sage Agastya (Uttara 7.35.11). Agastya's answer: as a fearless child, full of the gods' boons, Hanuman troubled the sages' hermitages, and the sages of the Bhrigu and Angiras lines cursed him: "the strength you lean on, you will not know it for a long time" (7.36.33). That is why he didn't act when Vali hounded Sugriva (7.36.39-40). In the Ramcharitmanas, Jambavan reminds him: "का चुप साधि रहेहु बलवाना". Both tellings are told with devotion.
